entries.description: Local-first browser app for speech-to-text dictation and multi-engine benchmarking. All recordings and transcripts stay in the user's browser IndexedDB.
representativeQueries: Transcribe speech to text in the browser without uploading audio to a backend server
Compare OpenAI GPT-Transcribe, Deepgram Nova-3, NVIDIA Parakeet, Fish Audio and Groq Whisper side by side
Dictate audio and keep transcript history stored locally
